claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Huperzine A is a potent, selective acetylcholinesterase inhibitor with no expected cytotoxicity at 2.5 uM; its only plausible antiproliferative effect would be weak, non-selective growth inhibition from cholinesterase inhibition or cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress, but this is unlikely to produce a distinct killing pattern.
